name: smwgraphics-grass-plains
title: Grass Plains
description:
This SMW looking background was ripped from a tileset sheet (having the same name as the submission) by the user Flagpole1up, so if you give credit to someone, give it to them.

Uses one GFX File, BG1, as well as Map16 Page 93 (make sure to change the map16 bank [cement block icon on the BG editor] to 01, or else you'll get garbage tiles).
